_comment: Base-image digests the platform is PINNED to (Dockerfile + docker-compose) and that generate-platform-sbom.mjs scans with Trivy, so the SBOM reflects exactly the deployed bytes. postgres digest captured from the running pqc-scanner-db container on the prod VPS; node digest pinned in the Dockerfile and applied on the next rebuild. Refresh these when bumping a base image, then re-pin + redeploy + regenerate the SBOM.
